name: 高考/考研倒计时（含工作日）

map.📅 高考/考研倒计时（含工作日）: 📅 Gaokao / Postgraduate Entrance Exam Countdown (with weekdays)
map.设置考试日期，统计剩余总天数与工作日，记录每日学习时长，追踪备考进度。: Set the exam date, count the remaining days and weekdays, log daily study hours and track your preparation progress.
map.📖 查看「高考/考研倒计时（含工作日） 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Gaokao / Postgraduate Entrance Exam Countdown User Guide"
map.剩余天数 = 目标日期 − 今天（按自然日取整）；工作日 = 区间内周一至周五的: Days remaining = target date − today (as whole calendar days); weekdays = the Monday-to-Friday days in the interval, skipping weekends automatically, used to estimate the number of working days available for preparation.
map.请设置考试名称与日期，并填写备考目标总时长。系统将自动计算剩余总天数、工作日（周: Set the exam name and date and enter your target total preparation time. The system automatically works out the remaining days together with the weekday (Monday to Friday) and weekend day counts. Use the daily study log to check in your study hours and track progress. All data is stored locally in your browser.
map.📚 深度解析：统计高考/考研等考试的剩余总天、工作日与周末天数，支持每日学习打卡: 📚 In-depth: counts the remaining total days, weekdays and weekend days until the Gaokao or postgraduate entrance exam, with daily study check-in and progress tracking.
map.每日打卡：记录学习时长。: Daily check-in: record your study hours.
map.示例：距考试 100 天，其中工作日约 71 天、周末 29 天。: Example: 100 days to the exam, of which about 71 are weekdays and 29 fall on weekends.
map.按周一到周五估算，忽略法定调休。: They are estimated as Monday to Friday, ignoring official holiday shifts.
map.记录每日投入，激励持续复习。: It records daily input and keeps revision going.
map.进度存浏览器本地，不上传。: Progress stays in the browser and is never uploaded.
map.关于「高考/考研倒计时（含工作日）」: About the Gaokao / Postgraduate Entrance Exam Countdown
map.面向高考、考研等考试的备考倒计时工具，自动统计剩余总天数、工作日与周末天数，支持: A countdown tool for the Gaokao, postgraduate entrance exam and similar exams: it automatically counts the remaining total days, weekdays and weekend days, supports daily study check-in and progress tracking to keep revision efficient.
map.考试倒计时大字显示，含励志寄语: Large countdown display with motivating messages
map.自动区分工作日与周末剩余天数: Separate counts of remaining weekdays and weekend days
map.每日学习时长打卡，同日可累加: Daily study check-in, same-day hours accumulate
map.累计/日均/目标完成度统计: Cumulative / daily average / target completion statistics
map.考试倒计时与学习打卡统计: Exam countdown and study check-in statistics
map.今日零点对齐：双方日期均 setHours(0,0,0,0): Midnight alignment: both dates are setHours(0,0,0,0)
map.区间统计：总天数、工作日数、周末数、周数: Range statistics: total days, workdays, weekends, weeks
map.工作日/周末按目标区间内逐日判定: Workdays/weekends are determined day by day within the target range
map.学习统计：累计时长 = Σ各条记录小时数: Study statistics: cumulative time = Σ hours of each record
map.学习天数 = 记录条数；日均 = 累计 ÷ 天数: Study days = number of records; daily average = cumulative ÷ days
map.目标完成率 = min(100, 累计 ÷ 目标时长 × 100)%: Target completion rate = min(100, cumulative ÷ target hours × 100)%
map.记录列表按日期降序（倒序）展示: The record list is shown by date descending (reverse order)
map.日期解析走 parseISO，无考试名称或日期时显示空态卡片: Dates are parsed with parseISO; an empty-state card is shown when there is no exam name or date
